sloka: वानरान् मोहयित्वा तु प्रतियातः स राक्षसः।चैत्यं निकुम्भिलां नाम यत्र होमं करिष्यति ।। ६.८४.१३ ।।
transliteration: vānarān mohayitvā tu pratiyātaḥ sa rākṣasaḥ।caityaṁ nikumbhilāṁ nāma yatra homaṁ kariṣyati ।। 6.84.13 ।।

translations.english: 'That rakshasa has gone back after merely deluding the monkeys. Know, O mighty-armed one, that daughter of Janaka to have been a mere creation of illusion.'
